<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

What these files depend on — impact the other way.

```text
Queries the map and shows, for one or more files, everything they depend on: what they
import or declare @dep of, the writers of what they read, what they capture or realize, and
the specs, features and guides that rule them. It is the other end of the ties 'impact'
follows.

  • Direct — what the files themselves depend on (the default).
  • --propagate indirect — one level further: what the direct ones depend on.
  • --propagate cascade  — the whole chain.

Each item past the first level carries the path that ties it to the file; an item that
depends on many others says how many it pulls (--stop-at <glob> lists it and goes no
further from it).

  --format text    grouped by level (default)
  --format files   the dependencies, one per line
  --format json    levels and paths

Query only — it opens no issue and changes nothing.
```

## Uso

```bash
anchors dependencies <file>... [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--format` | `text` | text \| files \| json |
| `--map` |  | path to the map (default: <root>/anchors.graph.yaml) |
| `--propagate` |  | past the direct level: indirect (one level more) or cascade (the whole chain) |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--stop-at` |  | glob of nodes listed but not walked past (repeatable or comma-separated) |

## Confronto do projeto — família

Comandos da mesma família — o que distingue cada um:

| Comando | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| [`anchors check`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/check/) | Run the quality gates (the pipeline) |
| [`anchors verify`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/verify/) | Run EVERYTHING the phase requires: Anchors gates + external tools |
| [`anchors coverage`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/coverage/) | Show coverage by scenario, by line, of the DIFF and the delta |
| [`anchors stale`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/stale/) | List stale edges — what changed and has not been reconfronted |
| [`anchors affected-tests`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/affected-tests/) | List the tests a change can break — by rule and region where the project declares them |
| [`anchors impact`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/impact/) | Impact analysis: who depends on these files, and the tests to run again |
| **`anchors dependencies`** | What these files depend on — impact the other way |
| [`anchors failures`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/failures/) | The observed failures that the spec has not yet explained |
